tei:titleStmt.tei:title: (āḥ)༄༅/ /rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi lag len gsal bar bshad pa'i yi ge mkha' spyod bgrod pa'i gsang lam zhes bya ba ba
(āḥ)༄༅/ /rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi lag len gsal bar bshad pa'i yi ge mkha' spyod bgrod pa'i gsang lam zhes bya ba ba

tei:div.tei:p: (āḥ)༄༅// rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi lag len gsal bar bshad pa'i yi ge mkha' spyod bgrod pa'i gsang lam zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༈ /na mo gu ru buddha dhwa dza badzra yo gi nī/ rgyal ba kun gyi spyi gzugs bla ma dang*// rdo rje btsun mo'i zhabs la gus btud nas// mkha' spyod dbang mo mchod pa'i sbyin sreg gi /cho ga'i lag len ma nor don tshang spel// 'dir rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bsnyen pa sngon du song bas gsang sngags kyi nus pa dbyung ba'i phyir zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya bar 'dod pas/ sbyor ba dngos gzhi rjes kyi bya ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/ thab kyi gzhi sa stegs gru bzhi 'thas pa/ de'i steng thig chen brgyad spyi dang mthun par btab la/ dbus nas khru gang bskor ba ni thab kyi tshad/ de'i nang du sor bzhi pa gnyis bskor ba ni kha khyer dang mu ran te/ de la rdo rje phreng ba kha zlum pas bskor ba bri/ de'i mtha' gru bzhir thig gdab la kha khyer sor bzhi byas pa'i nang gi grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rje kha zlum pas mtshan pa bri/ zlum skor nang ma'i nang nas lte ba'i bar gyi tshad des zlum skor dang shar nub gnyis kyi tshangs thig 'dzom steng bzung nas shar nub g.yas g.yon du rtags byas la/ shar gyi tshangs thig zlum thig 'dzom steng nas lho nub dang nub byang du thig gdab/ lho nub kyi rtags steng nas nub byang thig gdab/ de bzhin du nub kyi tshangs zlum thig 'dzom steng nas/ shar lho dang byang shar du thig gdab/ de nas shar lho dang byang shar gyi rtags steng gdab pas chos 'byung bsnol ma 'byung zhing*/ slar yang de'i nang du sor gang tsam gyi thig re btab/ chos 'byung gi re khā dkar po/ nang thams cad rdul tshon dmar pos bkang ste/ mdun rgyab spangs pa'i grwa bzhir dga' ba 'khyil pa g.yon skor du bri/ dbus su nyi ma'i gdan la tshom bu dmar po dgod/

thab kyi kha khyer la bud shing srog chags med pa'i lci ba skam po'am/ tsher ma can ma yin pa'i bud shing brtsigs la/ de'i 'jig rten pa'i shar lhor ting lo che ba gcig bshams rang nyid zhal shar du phyogs pa'i g.yon thab kyi g.yas su chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa lnga dang*/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma dam rdzas lnga bdun gsum la sogs pa dang*/ bskang ba'i gtor ma rgyas bsdus gang rigs sogs phyag len ltar dang*/ me lha la gtor ma zlum gtor gcig rnams bshams/ rang gi g.yas thab kyi g.yon du yam shing 'o ma can zhes pa lcang dkar la sogs pa gas grum med pa sbom phra mtheb chen nas mthe'u chung gi bar dang*/ ring thung sor brgyad pa'am/ khru gang ba'am sor bcu gnyis kyi tshad dang ldan pa'i rtse mor mar dang sbrang rtsi dang dri bzang gis byugs pa dang*/ 'bru mar ram/ mar bzhu ba/ til dang*/ las kyis shi ba'i ba lang gi sha dum bur gtubs shing brngos pa la chang la bdud rtsi ril bu btab pas sbags pa dang*/ zho mar phye gsum dang sbrang bu ram rnams bsres pa'i zas mchog ku sha dang*/ dūrwa dang*/ nas dang*/ gro dang*/ so ba dang*/ 'bras dang*/ sran ma dang*/ dzā ti la sogs pa'i 'bru sna tshogs bzhag pa'o// til nas 'bru sna tshogs kyi bar zangs sder sogs snod bzang por bkod nas bzhag go /ku sha yam shing la snod med par mchod gzhi'i steng du bkod pa'o// sgrub pa po'i mdun du nang mchod rdo rje dril bu/ de gnyis kyi bar du dgang gzar blugs gzar gnyis kha sbyar la bzhag dung chos dri bzang gi chus gang ba ku sha'i 'thor yab dang bcas pa 'thor nas ku sha'i chun po brgyad/ spor lde khru gang tsam pa yang bshams/ sgrub pa po dang thab kyi bar 'jim pa las byas pa'i me yol yang bsham pa ni sbyor ba'i chos so// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gsum/ bdag nyid lhar bskyed/ 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa/ 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa'o/

༈ /dang po ni/ phyi red kyi tshe sgrub pa po kha shar phyogs su bltas la/ gos dkar po gyon la sdig pa zhi ba'i sems dang ldan pas/ skyabs yul gsal 'debs nas brtsams te/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngang nas/ rang skad cig gis rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur/ zhes brjod cing*/ rang gi gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re'i steng du/ oṃ bam̐ ham̐ yoṃ hriṃ moṃ hriṃ hriṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ ces brjod pa'i bar kho bos byas pa'i sgrub thabs bzhin bya ba'am/ rang gang byed kyi bdag bskyed byas la/ de nas bsang chu byin rlabs ni/ sumbhas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ shaṃ las dung chos dri ma med pa'i nang du hūm̐ las bsang chus rdzas rnams kyi bgegs dang ma dag pa sel ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ zhes brjod cing*/ sumbha nyer gcig gis byin gyis brlabs shing*/ de nas bsang chu ku sha'i 'thor g.yab kyis thab dang yo byad rnams la gtor/ sumbhas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang*/ bsreg rdzas rnams gtsang zhing yid du 'ong ba zhi ba'i las sgrub pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ arghaṃ/ pa dyāṃ/ puṣpe/ dhu paṃ/ a lo ke/ ghandhe/ nai wi dye/ shabda āḥhūm̐/ oṃ shrī swā hā/ oṃ dzrīṃ swā hā/ oṃ oṃ swā hā/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ zhes brjod/ ༈ /gnyis pa 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ yang thab la bsang chu gtor la/ sumbhas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las padma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du/

hūm̐ las zhi ba'i thab khung dkar po zlum po rgyar khru gang*/ zabs su khru phyed/ kha khyer dang mu ran la rdo rjes mtshan zhing*/ phyi rol stegs bu gru bzhi pa grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes brgyan pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa bud shing rtsigs pa dang bcas pa'i dbus su ram̐ las bgrang phreng ram̐ gyis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ me lha ra skyes la zhon pa sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang pos mchog sbyin/ gnyis pas bgrang phreng*/ g.yon gyi dang pos dbyug gu rtse gsum pa/ gnyis pas gundhe 'dzin pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang ldan zhing tshangs pa'i skud pa dang kṛṣṇa sa ra'i pags pa'i stod g.yog dang dmar po'i sham thabs can/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas/ shar lho nas me lha 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ dbyug gu rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya rna ba'i drung du g.yab cing*/ oṃ tshur byon tshur byon 'byung po che// me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /bsreg blug zhal zas bzhes slad du// 'di nyid du ni gshegs su gsol// gzi brjid chen po me yi lha// 'dod pa thams cad sgrub pa po// thugs rjes sems can don mdzad pa// 'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol// oṃ e hye hi ma hā bhu ta/ de wa ri ṣi dwi dza sa twa ma gri hi to ma hā asminsanni hi to bha wa/ agne ye i hye hi dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pā ri wā ra arghaṃ nas shabda'i bar gyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa khyed rnams kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/

sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan/ mtshan sngags sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa lnga/ nang mchod/ 'jig rten dbang phyug sogs kyis bstod/ de nas ku sha'i chun po brgyad la bsang chu gtor zhing*/ sumbhas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i ku sha sngo ljang rtsa ba dang rtse mo ma nyams pa 'bags pa dang ma dag pa sel ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ ku sha 'di ni gtsang zhing dge /hūm̐ las skyes pa'i snying po mchog /dkon mchog gsum gyi dag byed de// tshangs pa yi ni dag byed yin// 'dis bdag cag gi bgegs dang mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi zhing las kyi dngos grub kyang stsal du gsol/ oṃ badzra satwa āḥ ma ma shīntaṃ kurwantu swā hā/ zhes brjod cing*/ ku sha'i rtse mo phyogs g.yon skor dang mtshams g.yas skor du thab kyi phyogs mtshams brgyad du 'bul/ de nas sbyin sreg gi gzhung rnams su gong du me 'bar bar bshad kyang phyag len la skabs 'dir mdzad pas/ spor lde sbar nas thab la g.yon phyogs su lan gsum bskor zhing*/ oṃ badzra dzwa la raṃ zhes pas thab nang gi ting lo sbar/ me ni rdo dang lcags rtsub pa las byung ba ma yin pa/ rgyun zhag gi me'am 'o ma can rtsub pa la byung ba'o// phus mi brdab/ rlung g.yab kyis sbar ro// de nas yam shing gzhan dang bcas pas me legs par 'bar du bcug cing*/ mar blugs gzar gsum dzwa la'i sngags kyis me gso/ de nas me lha'i lce hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa la ram̐ bsam/ dgang blug gi kha la yang ram̐ bsam la/ oṃ agna ye swā hā/ gzar blug bdun gyis dgang blug mar gyis bkang*/ oṃ agna ye a di pyā di pya a bhi sha ma hā/ a bhi sha ma hā shrī ha bya ka bya/ ba hā na ye/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib dam tshig nyams chag gsang sngags lhag chad kyi nyes pa thams cad shīntaṃ ku ru swā hā/

zhes lan gsum gyis byon zan 'bul/ skabs 'dir me pra brtag cing*/ ngan na hūm̐ zhes brjod cing bsang chu gtor/ dgang blugs kha sbyar la lan gsum bskor/ oṃ agna ye zhes pa kun la sbyar ba'i arghaṃ nas shabda'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ agna ye oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas nang mchod 'bul/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras// me lha'i rgyal po ḍā kis dbang bskur ba// shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad bsreg /'dzin byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud// ces pas bstod/ de nas bsreg rdzas 'bul ba ni/ yam shing nas dza ti la sogs pa'i 'bru sna tshogs kyi bar rim pa bzhin lag pa g.yon pas bzung la/ g.yas pas mtheb srin gyis steng nas blangs shing cung zad bskor te mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgyas phul/ dang po yam shing la/ oṃ badzra dzwa la dzwa la ye bo dhi brikṣa ye swā hā/ mar la/ oṃ agna ye swā hā/ til la/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badzrā ye swā hā/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga la/ oṃ ma dā na ba la pañtsa a mṛ ta swā hā/ zas mchog la/ oṃ sarba saṃ pa de ye swā hā/ ku sha la/ oṃ badzra a pra ti ha ta badzra ye swā hā/ dūrwa la/ oṃ badzra a yu ṣe swā hā/ nas la/ oṃ ma hā bāe ga ye swā hā/ gro la/ oṃ badzra ghasma ri ye swā hā/ so ba la/ oṃ badzra bi dza ye swā hā/ 'bras la/ oṃ badzra puṣṭa ye swā hā/ sran ma la/ oṃ ma hā ba la ye swā hā/ dza ti la sogs pa 'bru sna tshogs la/ oṃ ma hā shrī pha la brta ni swā hā/ zhes pas bsreg rdzas rnams sngags dang bcas pa lan bdun re'i mjug tu/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib dam tshig chag nyams sngags lhag chad kyi nyes pa thams cad shīntaṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes pa'i spel tshig brjod cing dbul/ slar yang gong ltar mchod bstod byas nas mar blugs gzar gang thab nang blugs la/ oṃ agne dzwa la ram̐/ me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur/

zhes brjod pa rnams kyis 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa'o/ ༈ /gsum pa 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ slar yang me gso ba'i phyir bud shing brtsigs pa dang*/ mchod pa dang bsreg rdzas rnams kha gsos la/ mchod pa dang bsreg rdzas rnams gong bzhin byin gyis brlabs la/ de nas thab la bsang chu gtor zhing sumbha bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las me 'bar ba'i dbus su/ yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor zhes pa nas/ 'og min nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pa'i bar mdun bskyed ltar las/ de nas rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*// sogs shlau ka gsum dang*/ oṃ badzra yo gi nī e hye hi badzra sa mā dzaḥzhes pas ye shes pa spyan drangs/ phyi nang gi mchod bstod bya/ oṃ yo gi nī ye a de byā de byā bi shuddhe ma hā shrī ye ha bya ka bya ba ha na ya/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib dam tshig nyams chag sngags lhag chad gyi nyes pa thams cad shīntaṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes pa lan gsum gyis gong bzhin mar gyi byon zan dbul/ dgang blugs kha sbyar nas thab la lan gsum bskor/ de nas mdun bskyed ltar dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim zhes pa nas rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan par zhes pa'i bar bya zhing*/ de nas/ oṃ badzra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra sngon du 'gro ba'i chu gnyis sogs kyi phyi mchod dang*/ oṃ badzra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi nang mchod dang*/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// shlau ka gnyis kyis bstod/ de nas bsreg rdzas 'bul ba ni/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phul bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ badzra yo gi nī oṃ badzra dzwa la dzwa la bo dhi bṛkṣa ya sarba pa pām̐ shīntaṃ ku ru ye swā hā/

zhes pas yam shing*/ de bzhin du thog mtha' gnyis 'dra ba la/ bo dhi bri kṣa'i gnas su mar sogs rdzas so so'i sngags bcug la 'bul/ bsnyen pa bzhi 'bum byas tshe rdzas til lam yungs kar gang rung la sngags oṃ gsum ma la bcu cha'i grangs khri tsho bzhi'i grangs 'dzin dgos pa de'i tshul ni/ nyi ma lnga'i dang po la cho ga gcig dang*/ bar pa gsum la cho ga gnyis gnyis lnga pa la sngags chog ste cho ga brgyad la sngags lnga stong re re bzla dgos shing*/ bsreg rdzas gzhan rnams kyang brgyad dang bcu re 'bul dgos pas/ dus gcig la phul na me mi 'bar ba'i skyon yod pas sngags lnga brgya re song mtshams rdzas rnams bcu tshan re 'bul zhing bdag dang sems can thams cad sogs spel tshig lan re brjod/ thog mtha' gnyis gong bzhin no// bar gyi bcu tshan dgu po oṃ gsum 'ba' zhig gis 'bul lo// yang lce bde ba la sogs pas nyi ma bdun du byed dgos byung tshe/ cho ga bcu gnyis su byas pa'i cho ga re la sngags gsum stong lnga brgya re bzla zhing*/ bsreg rdzas rnams sngags gsum brgya re song mtshams 'bul ba la sogs gong gi rigs 'gres shes par bya zhing*/ de ltar byas pas sngags bzhi khri lhag tsam 'gro'o// de yang bsreg rdzas rnams mar dang sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga zas mchog rnam gsum zhal du/ ku sha dang dūr wa'i myu gu dbu'i gtsug tor la/ 'bru la sogs pa gong bu'i rdzas rnams phyag tu phul bar bsam mo// mthar gang ba'i sbyin sreg sogs byon zas bzhin mar lan bdun spel tshig dang bcas pa 'bul/ de nas gong bzhin phyi mchod nang mchod bstod pa rnams bya/ bsnyen pa 'bru 'bum byas tshe bcu cha'i sbyin sreg sogs gong gi rigs 'gres sbyar bar bya'o/ ༈ /de nas gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ kho bos byas pa'i dkyil chog gi gtor ma byin rlabs ltar byas la/ nyi ma dang po'i thun dang*/ rjes ma'i thun/ nyi ma bar ma'i dgong thun rnams la gtor bsngo rgyas pa las/

'di nyid gtor bsngo dkyil chog ltar bya zhing*/ spro na bskang ba bstod pa sogs skabs dang sbyar ba so so'i phyag len bzhin bya/ nyi ma bar ma'i snga thun la byin rlabs nas/ bdag la rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig /ces pa'i bar dkyil chog ltar gyis phul/ de nas gur zhal dur khrod bdag po las mgon/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor/ gzhi bdag rnams la gtor ma 'bul ba bstod pa nas/ de yis sangs rgyas myur thob shog gi bar gtor bsngo 'bring po ltar bya/ de nas he ru ka'i yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyi rjes su/ ma 'byor pa sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol zhing lhag chad kha skong*/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzod sogs kyi rjes su/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra muḥye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la gnyis su med par thim/ zhes brjod cing lag pa g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis thal ba cung zad blangs la dpral ba/ mgrin pa/ snying ga rnams su thig le bya/ 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa'o/ ༈ /gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba ni/ mar blugs gzar gang thab tu blug la/ oṃ badzra dzwa la ram̐ me lha sngar bzhin zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa'i skur gyur/ de nas bsreg rdzas lhag ma rnams so so'i sngags dang bcas pa las ji ltar rigs pa phul rjes gong bzhin spel tshig dang bcas pas 'bul/ sngar ltar mchod bstod byas la me lha'i gtor ma de/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥs lan gsum gyi phyag rgya dang bcas pas byin gyis brlabs nas/ oṃ agna ye na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyoḥzhes sogs lan gsum gyis phul/ de nas sngar bzhin phyi nang gi mchod bstod byas la/ oṃ agna ye badzra muḥ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim/ slar yang yi ge brgya pa lan gsum dang*/ ma 'byor pa sogs kyis lhag chad kha skong*/ gtor mgron gyi rten yod pa rnams la brtan bzhugs/ med pa la gshegs gsol byas la/ de nas rang gi gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re'i steng du/

lte bar oṃ bam̐ dmar mo rdo rje phag mo zhes sogs nas/ yan lag thams cad phaṭa phaṭa dud kha tsaṇḍi ka'i ngo bo rnams gsal bar gyur/ zhes pa'i bar gyi go cha dgod/ sumbha tshar gnyis brjod cing sdigs mdzub phyogs g.yon skor dang*/ mtshams g.yas skor du bstan la tshams rngam sngags kyis bsrungs/ hūm̐ bdag dang snang ba'i dngos po thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku'i rang bzhin/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba buddha sogs tshar gcig brjod la/ brjod pa dang grags pa'i sgra thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i gsung gi rang bzhin/ hūm̐ sems kyi rnam par rtog pa'i cho 'phrul thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i thugs rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin du rnam par dag pa yin no// zhes pas dga' ba gsum dran par byas nas/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /sogs nas/ bdag la rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig /ces pas smon lam btab la/ phun tshogs dge legs kun gyi dpal mnga' ba// sogs 'di nyid kyi bkra shis dang*/ gzhan yang yi dam chos skyong nor lha sogs kyi bkra shis brjod la me tog gi char dbab cing*/ thal ba rnams chu bor dor/ las kyi rjes mi mngon par bsdu'o// de dag gis ni rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga gsal bar bstan zin to/ ༈ /de ltar rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// sbyin sreg cho ga mkha' spyod gsang lam 'di// bstan pa'i nyi ma sngags 'chang chen po yi// thugs sras rgyal tshab 'jam dbyangs sku mched dang*// 'khor lo sdom pa sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gyi// zhabs zung brten pa'i sngags 'chang sa skya pa// ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams zhes bya bas// rigs dang chos kyi bu sogs dad ldan gyi// slob ma rnams dang rang nyid nyams len phyir// lcags 'brug khrums gyi zla ba'i dkar phyogs la// dpal ldan sa skya'i bzhi thog bla brang gi /yang rtse bkra shis brtsegs kyi khang bzang du// sbyar ba 'di yi yi ge'i 'du byed pa// rang gi mchod g.yog dge slong rdo rje 'dzin// rnam dpyod blo ldan ngag dbang dpal bzang gis// dad dang brtson 'grus chen pos legs par bgyis// legs byas 'dis mtshon dus gsum dge ba'i mthus// bdag cag gdul byar bcas pa'i sdig sgrib kun// byang zhing dag nas 'di dang phyi ma'i don// yid la re ba ji bzhin 'grub gyur cig/

༈ /rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sbyin sreg shin tu bsdus pa sgrib pa rnam sel zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༈ /na mo gu ru badzra wā ra hī/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sbyin sreg shin tu bsdus pa ni/ rdza sdar sogs snod gtsang mar lci ba'i me sogs dbugs dang rdzas ngan kyis ma bslad pa mdun du bshams la/ chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod bshams pa'am/ ma bshams kyang rung*/ til mang nyung ji ltar rigs par bshams la/ rnal 'byor ma'i bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa grub 'phral yin pa'am/ rje btsun ma 'di kho na'i nyams len byed pa rnams kyis de'i nga rgyal dang*/ gzhan thun mtshams kyi lha gang rung wal gyis bsams la/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma sogs skyabs sems ji ltar rigs pa dang*/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs kyis tshad med bzhi bsgom/ me snod dang bcas pa/ sumbhas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las padma dang*/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las zhi ba'i thab khung dkar po zlum po rgyar khru gang*/ zabs su khru phyed kha khyer dang mu ran la rdo rje'i phreng bas mtshan pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus su e e las chos 'byung dmar po gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi nang du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bam̐ yig dmar po'i mthar g.yon skor du/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba buddha ḍā ki nī ye/ badzra warṇa nī ye/ badzra bai ro tsa nī ye/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags phreng kha dog dmar pos bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yig 'bru rnams la thim pa yongs su gyur pa las rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur pa ni/ sna tshogs padma dang nyi ma'i gdan la zhabs g.yas brkyang pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo nu ma'i steng nas mnan pa/

g.yon bskums pas 'jigs byed nag po'i mgo bo rgyab tu bltab nas mnan pa/ sku mdog dmar mo bskal pa'i me lta bu'i gzi brjid can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum dag pa mkha' spyod du gzigs pa/ phyag g.yas pas rdo rje'i mtshan pa'i gri gug thur du brkyang nas 'dzin pa/ g.yon pas thod pa khrag gis gang ba steng phyogs su bzung nas zhal gyen du phyogs pas gsol ba/ phrag pa g.yon par rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭwāṃ ga la ḍā ma ru dang*/ dril bu dang*/ 'phan rtse gsum pa 'phyang bzhin pa bsnams pa/ dbu skra nag po sil bur gyur pas sku rked yan chad khebs pa/ lang tsho dar la bab cing 'dod pa'i nu 'bur rgyas pa/ bde ba bskyed pa'i nyams can/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ gcer bu phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// zhes brjod pas mdun bskyed kyi dam tshig pa bskyed/ de nas ye shes pa bstim zhing go cha dgod pa dang*/ dbang bskur rigs kyi bdag pos rgyas gdab pa rnams ni/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya smin mtshams su g.yon skor du lan gsum bskor zhing ngag tu/ phaiṃ/ rang gi thugs ka'i bam̐ yig las 'od zer 'phros pas 'og min nas rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ pad kor gyi mthar 'khyud pa'i phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ yo ga shuddhoḥsarba dharmāḥyo ga shuddho3haṃ/ de'i gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ lte bar oṃ bam̐ dmar mo rdo rje phag mo/ snying gar ham̐ yoṃ sngon mo gshin rje ma/ khar hriṃ moṃ dkar mo rmongs byed ma/ dpral bar hriṃ hriṃ ser mo skyod byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang gu skrag byed ma/

yan lag thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa dud kha tsaṇḍi ka'i ngo bor gyur/ slar yang rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha dpal 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor mdun gyis nam mkhar oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan/ zhes brjod cing bsam/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra gcig sngon du 'gro ba'i arghaṃ nas/ shabda āḥhūm̐ gi bar dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sogs shlau ka gnyis sam gcig gis bstod/ rang gi rkang 'og tu yam̐ las rlung*/ sum mdor ram̐ las me/ lte bar rigs drug gi sa bon bag chags dang bcas pa/ snying khar tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad kaṃ nag po'i rnam par gnas pa la rkang 'og gi rlung g.yos/ sum mdo'i me sbar/ lte ba'i rigs drug gi sa bon bag chags dang bcas pa dang*/ snying kha'i sdig sgrib kyi ngo bo kaṃ yig sna sgor 'thon pa sdig pa rwa can gyi rnam par gyur nas mdun gyi til la thim par gyur/ g.yas pas snod bzung g.yon pas mtheb srin gyis til me la bsreg pa dang mnyam du oṃ gsum ma bton lan gsum lnga bdun brgya phrag sogs ji ltar rigs pas phul ba'i mthar/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mas bdag gi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib spyi dang khyad par gsang sngags kyi dam tshig dang sdom pa la nyams chag dang sngags gyi nyes pa thams cad shīntaṃ ku ru swā hā/

gong bzhin mchod pa bya ba'am/ ma byas kyang rung*/ he ru ka'i yig brgya ji ltar rigs pa'i mthar/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs shlau ka gcig oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra muḥ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /mkha' spyod ma dpal 'grub gyur nas// sogs dang*/ 'chi tshe mgon dang sogs/ lha mo tshad ma sogs/ padma rā ga'i sogs kyi bkra shis bya'o// ༈ /oṃ swa sti siddhaṃ/ de las kyang bsdu na bshams sogs gong bzhin la/ sumbha dang*/ swā bhā wa sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las padma dang nyi ma'i steng du zhi ba'i thab khung mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su chos 'byung gnyis brtsegs kyi nang du pad zla'i steng du bam̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ phaiṃ/ badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan/ arghaṃ nas/ shabda'i bar dang*/ 'bru gsum/ bstod pa shlau ka gcig rang gi snying ga nas sdig sgrib kyi ngo bo kaṃ yig gi rnam par sna sgor 'thon nas sdig pa rwa can gyi rnam par mdun gyi til la thim par gyur/ oṃ gsum mas phul mthar/ spel tshig gong bzhin gyi rjes su/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ badzra muḥ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /mkha' spyod ma dpal 'grub gyur nas// sogs shlau ka gcig brjod pas don tshang bar sems so// 'chi tshe mgon dang sogs/ lha mo tshad ma sogs/ padma rā ga'i sogs sngar bzhin bya'o// sbyin sreg gi thal ba ri dang chu sogs la bskyal ba ma gtogs mi gtsang ba'i gnas su mi 'dor zhing*/ 'gom yug dang 'bag gtsog ma shor ba gal che/ 'di rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sbyin sreg gi man ngag la gzhi byas mkha' spyod ma'i khyad chos rnams bcug pa 'gal ba cung zad kyang med par sems te/ gsang sngags rgyud sde phal cher rang rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i nyams len ma chad phyin/ thun mong rgyud sde gzhan nas bskang du rung ba tshad ldan du ma nas bshad pa'i phyir nyes pa med par sems shing*/

mar me'i sbyin sreg sogs yig cha khung thub kha gsal can gzhan nas rtogs par bya'o// 'di ni bsod nams 'od zer gyi 'dod pa bzhin sa skya pa kun dga' blo gros kyis sbyar ba'o// ༈ /rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod ma la brten pa'i las bzhi'i sbyin sreg bklags pas don grub ces bya ba bzhugs so// ༈ /oṃ swa sti/ rje btsun dpal ldan bla ma dang*// dbyer med rdo rje rnal 'byor mar// gus btud de mnyes byed pa'i thabs// sreg blugs cho ga bshad kyis nyon// de la 'dir rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i las bzhi'i sbyin sreg bya bar 'dod pas/ thog mar zhi ba'i sbyin sreg ni/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyis mdzad pa'i yi ge ltar nyams su blangs pas don 'grub cing*/ 'dir de la ltos pa'i rgyas pa dang*/ dbang dang*/ drag po gsum rnam gzhag 'chad par byed pa la/ dang po zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gnyis pa rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg bya ba'i tshul la sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi dang po la chos drug yod pa'i/ dang po thab ni rtsigs pa brus pa gang bde yin kyang phyag len la rtsigs pa gtso bor mdzad pas/ sngar gyi zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi shul lam/ 'di kha rkyang pa byed na/ thab stegs gru bzhi khru do ba'i tshad byi dor byas pa'i steng du thig chen brgyad spyi mthun btab pa'i dbus nas phyogs bzhir khru gang gi tshad bzhag pa'i steng du gru bzhi'i thig btab/ de'i phyi sor bzhi'i thig gnyis btab pa kha khyer dang mu ran/ gru bzhi'i nang dbus su chos 'byung gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi dbus su rdo rje'i tshon spung dmar po/ zur drug tu dga' 'khyil re/ phyi rol gyi kha khyer la rin po che'i phreng ba/ de'i phyi rol gyi zur bzhir zla phyed rdo rje rtse nang du bstan pa re bri zhing*/ tshon gyi kha dog ser po shas che ba/ bcad rnams ci mdzes su bya'o// gnyis pa bud shing ni 'bras bu can gyi shing ser shas che ba thab kyi kha khyer gyi steng du gru bzhir rtsigs/

mthar nang gi shar lhor zan gyi ting lo che ba/ mar khu ser pos bkang ba bshams/ gsum pa me ni rgyal po'i thab nas byung ba'am/ dge 'dun gyi bsro khang nas byung ba'i mes bya'o// bzhi pa zhi ba'i skabs kyi rdzas bcu gcig dang*/ sha dang bdud rtsi de bcu gsum/ de thams cad yung ba kha che sogs kyis ser por bsgyur/ khyad par yam shing ni 'bras bu can gyi shing gi rigs ya yo khyag khyog med pa/ sbom phra zhi ba dang 'dra/ ring thung skum khru gang*/ rtsa rtse mnyam par bcad pa/ sbrang rtsi dang mar gyis bskus pa/ grangs brgya dang lnga bcu tsam/ lnga pa thab kyi bshams thabs ni/ rang gi g.yas su stegs bu'i steng du go rim ma nor bar bshams/ ku sha'i chun po brgyad kyang bsham mo// mar khu yang yung bas kha bsgyur/ rang gi mdun du me yol zhi ba ltar dgang gzar blugs gzar kyang kha sbyar nas mdun du mar khu'i steng du bzhag rang gi g.yon thab kyi g.yas su stegs bu stegs khebs sogs kyis bkab pa'i steng du gtor ma gnyis/ mdun du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod thams cad kha dog ser por bsgyur ba rang gi mdun du cog rtse'i steng g.yon nas rim bzhin nang mchod dril bu rdo rje ḍā ma ru/ me tog gi phor bu/ bsang chu'i snod du dung chos dri bzang gi chus gang ba lce lde mar khu byug pa/ rlung g.yab ser po gos zung rnams bshams/ drug pa sgrub pa po ni chas gos ser po 'byor na bya zhing*/ thab kyi lho nas kha byang bstan gyis sa 'ja' li lta bur bzang po'i 'dug hor stegs stangs kyis 'dug go /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la chos drug gi dang po bdag gi rnal 'byor ni/ skyabs 'gro nas bzung bsam mi khyab kyi 'jug bsdu ba'i bar tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i rgyun gyi ngag 'don ltar bzlas pa ji tsam 'os pa dang bcas grub nas/ gnyis pa me btsal ba ni/ sngar gyi me de nyid la lce lde sbar ba lag pa thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du bzung*/

ngag tu/ oṃ dzwa la dzwa la hūm̐ zhes dang*/ oṃ gsum ma brjod cing thab la g.yas skor gyi gru bzhi'i tshul du bskor nas mchod g.yog pas ting lo me sbar/ rtswa skam po dang bcas me gso shaṃ las dung phor mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i nang du hūm̐ las byung ba'i bsang chu dwangs zhing thogs pa med pa rdzas rnams kyi ma dag pa sel ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur par bsams la/ sumbha ni dang*/ bdun brjod/ de nas mchod rdzas rnams dang bsreg rdzas rnams la'ang 'thor te/ bsang sbyangs byin rlabs zhi ba'i skabs ltar brjod/ bzhi pa thab khung 'dus bya ba ni/ yang thab la gtor/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rgyas pa'i thab khung ser po gru bzhi pa rgya dang tshad ma chad pa kha khyer la rin po che'i phreng bas bskor ba zur bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa nang lha rdzas kyi bud shing gis yongs su gang bar gyur zhes brjod/ lnga pa 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ me 'bar ba'i dbus su zhes sogs ni zhi ba ltar las/ mdangs dang 'od zer ser po 'phro ba zhes brjod/ de'i dpral bar oṃ zhes pa nas chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan zhes pa'i bar brjod/ 'di'i 'don cha kha 'phangs pa rnams rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan gyis mdzad pa nas len/ de nas ku sha bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las zhes sogs nas bkram pa'i bar dang*/ de nas bsreg rdzas 'bul ba'i dus su gzar bu rin po che'i khu tshur gyis bzung ba dang*/ spel tshig gi dus bdag gi tshe dang bsod nams thams cad puṣṭiṃ ku ru oṃ zhes brjod pa ma gtogs gzhan thams cad 'dra/ bsreg rdzas yam shing lta bur mtshon na/ oṃ agna ye bho dhi bhṛkṣa ye bdag gi tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor snyan grags thams cad puṣṭiṃ ku ru oṃ zhes dang*/ gzhan gyi don yin na sbyin bdag 'di zhes bgyi ba'i tshe dang bsod nams zhes sogs lta bur sbyar ba thams cad la rigs 'gre'o// de nas me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur zhes pa'i bar thams cad zhi ba dang 'dra/

drug pa 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa ni me bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las chos 'byung gi nang du paṃ las sna tshogs padma dang zhes pa nas rin chen byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan zhes pa ma gtogs zhi ba dang 'dra/ sku las 'od zer ser po 'phros pas bdag gi tshe dang bsod nams bskyed pa'i nus pa ldan par gyur/ ces brjod/ de nas byon zan 'bul ba'i dus su oṃ gsum ma lha sngags dang*/ spel tshigs me lha ltar brjod/ mchod pa rgyas pa mchod phreng ltar dang*/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos mdzad pa'i kha sbyor yan lag bdun ldan gyi sgo nas bstod/ bsreg rdzas dngos gzhi me lha'i skabs ltar 'bul ba la khyad par med/ oṃ gsum lha sngags dang*/ oṃ bho dhi bṛkṣa ye rdzas sngags/ bdag gi tshe dang bsod nams sogs las sngags te tshar sbrel ba nyer gcig sogs kyi mthar rdzas sngags rkyang pas phul/ mthar yang sum char sbrel nas 'phul ba sha'i bar thams cad la rigs 'gre zhing*/ lha sngags dngos gzhi'i bsreg rdzas 'bul ba'i dmigs pa mi 'dra ba'i khyad par sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu/ phyag bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa dang rin po che'i tshogs du ma 'dzin pas bdag la dbang bskur ba'i tshe dang bsod nams rgyas par gyur zhing*/ rin po che'i char babs pas nor gyi dngos grub stsol/ mdun bskyed kyi sku las kyang 'od zer ser po 'phros pas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi tshe dang bsod nams rgyas par bsam/ gzhan don byed pa'i dmigs pa yang mdun bskyed kyi mdun du pad zla'i gdan la bsgrub bya gang yin pa de rgyan gos ser pos brgyan pa la mdun bskyed kyi spro bsdu rgyas pa'i las mdzad par bsam mo// de nas mchod bstod bum bskyed ltar/ gtor ma rje btsun ma dang mkha' 'gro spyi gtor 'bul ba'am/ spro na chos skyong gi gtor 'bul yang bya/ sngar ltar byon skyems bdun tshan gsum 'bul/

rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mas bdag dang sems can thams cad dag pa mkha' spyod du 'khrid pa dang*/ tshe dang bsod nams thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes dngos grub blangs he ru ka'i yig brgyas lhag chad kha bskang*/ bdag cag las dang po pa'i rten gyi gang zag tu gyur pas cho ga lhag pa dang*/ chad pa dang*/ sngags ma dag pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin mi gsal ba dang*/ mchod pa'i yo byad ma 'byor pa la sogs pa'i skyon du gyur pa thams cad bzod par mdzad nas lhag chad kha bskang bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes nongs pa bzod par gsol/ oṃ khyed kyis sogs kyis gshegs gsol bya ba sogs dang*/ go cha'i sngags kyi bsrung ba sogs gzhung ltar brjod/ gsum pa mjug gi cho ga la chos drug las/ dang po me lha lhag ma'i mchod pa mar khu blugs gzar gang phul ba'i me lha 'bar ba'i rnam pa las rang gzugs su byon pa la gshegs skyems 'bul ba bsreg rdzas lhag ma 'bul ba rgyas pa'i spel tshig dang bcas/ mchod bstod rnams bya/ gnyis pa gtor ma gzhung ltar byas nas/ gsum pa bzod par gsol/ bzhi pa bdag gi don dang sogs gshegs gsol/ lnga pa rang gi gnas rnams bsrung shing go cha'i sngags brjod/ drug pa las bsags pa don du bya ba'i phyir bsngo smon shis brjod sogs gzhung ltar bya zhing*/ dri bzang gi chus me dal bus gzhil/ thab shul dri bzang gis bkru/ thal ba bsdu tshul gzhung ltar bya'o/ ༈ /gsum pa de la ltos pa'i dbang gi sbyin sreg ni/ gzhan thams cad zhi rgyas dang 'dra la/ thab ni thig chen brgyad mthun pa'i dbus nas sor bzhi dor ba'i mtshan ma byas pa'i dbus dang phyogs bzhir khru gang gis mtshan ma btab pa'i bar gyi srad bu des shar lho dang byang shar gyi zur thig gi bar bskor ba'i zla gam 'byung zhing*/ de'i phyi rol du sor gnyis bskor ba kha khyer dang mu ran shar ngos kyi thig sna sbrel ba'i zla gam gsum 'byung zhing*/

dbus su chos 'byung gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi thig gdab pa'i dbus su tshon spung dmar po dang zur drug tu dga' 'khyil re re bri/ phyi rol du stegs bu gru bzhi'i thig btab pa'i zur bzhi zla phyed rdo rje rtse lnga nang du bstan pa bri/ de yang zla gam gi bcad kha shar du bstan pa tshon dmar po 'ba' zhig la bcad rnams ci mdzes su bya/ kha khyer la lcags kyu phreng bas bskor ba ni thab dang kha khyer gyi steng du shing ni tsher ma can ma yin pa'i ro skyur ba'i bud shing zla gam gyi dbyibs su brtsigs/ shar lhor ting lo dang me gso ba'i rtswa skam/ lce lde mar khu dmar pos byug pa/ rlung g.yab dmar po dang bcas pa bsham/ rang gi g.yas phyogs su stegs kyi steng du bud shing gi rgyu las byung ba'i yam shing sor brgyad pa kha dog dmar por bsgyur ba mi 'byor na bal bu dang 'om bu sogs kyis kyang rung bar bshad/ mar khu dmar po/ me tog dmar po'i rigs gang 'dzom/ til lam yungs kar/ mngar gsum sbyar ba'i zas mchog 'bras/ so ba/ 'bras ma chag pa/ nas/ gro/ sran ma/ dūrwa/ ku sha/ ba glang gi sha/ bdud rtsi ste 'di rnams kha dog bsgyur thub pa rnams dmar por bya/ rang gi g.yon du gtor ma dmar po gnyis chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod thams cad dmar por bsgyur/ rang gi mdun du bsang chu'i dung phor/ 'thor g.yab dang bcas pa/ rdor dril/ nang mchod/ ḍā ma ru/ 'thor nas kyi snod sogs sta gon bya/ dngos gzhi ni phyi dro'i dus su rgyan gos dmar po dang ldan pas kha nub phyogs su bstan pas stan dmar po'i steng du padma'i 'dug stangs kyis gnas te khams gsum dbang du bsdu ba'i bsam pa dang ldan pas/ bdag bskyed brtsams nas mjug gi bar thams cad phal cher zhi ba dang 'dra ba las/ mi 'dra ba'i khyad par me smad tshong ma'i me'am/ lam du sprang pos bus pa'i me blang*/ dgang gzar padma'i khu tshur gyis bzung*/

me lha yang mdangs dang 'od zer dmar po 'phro ba/ 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan zhes dang*/ spel tshig gi dus khams gsum gyi zas nor longs spyod thams cad wa shaṃ ku ru hoḥ zhes 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa la yang rigs 'gres gzhan mjug gi bar thams cad zhi ba 'dra ba las dbang gi spel tshig dgos pa rnams ma 'dres par bya'o// ༈ /bzhi pa zhi rgyas la ltos drag po'i sbyin sreg 'di phal cher zhi rgyas dbang gsum ltar las/ mi 'dra ba thab kyi khyad par thig chen brgyad spyi dang mthun par btab pa'i dbus nas mtho gang gi tshad zlum por bskor ba'i dbus dang*/ byang gi bar gyi srad bu g.yas g.yon gang slebs kyi bar rtags byas pa'i steng du thig btab pas gru gsum 'byung ba'i phyi rol du sor re ba gnyis btab pas kha khyer dang mu ran/ dbus su chos 'byung nyis brtsegs kyi thig btab pa'i dbus su tshom bu bkod/ zur drug tu dga' 'khyil re phyi rol du stegs bu khru bzhi pa'i grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rje/ kha khyer la gri gug phreng ba bri zhing gzhi tshon thams cad nag po la bcad dmar pos bya'o// bud shing ni drag po'i shing tsher ma can gyi kha khyer gyi steng du gru gsum khru gang tsam brtsigs/ nang du ting lo mar nag gis sbags pa bzhag chos 'byung gi rtse lho phyogs su bstan/ rang gi g.yon du stegs bu'i steng du sngar gyi bud shing gi rgyu las byung ba'i yam shing sor bcu pa drug cu re/ me lhar bcu bzhi/ mar nag skye tshe sogs gong ltar las/ snod gcig tu lcags phye zangs phye/ dug khrag khrag sna blug pa bsham/ gzhan 'dra/ rang gi g.yas su gtor ma gnyis/ chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod nag po bsgyur ba/ rang gi mdun du rdor dril sogs thams cad gong dang 'dra bar bshams shing*/ srod kyi dus su gcan gzan gdug pa can gyi pags pa'i gdan nam/ stan med par cog pur 'dug la thab kyi byang du shar lhor kha bstan/

dgra bgegs gdug pa can bsgral ba'i bsam pa'i rgyan gos nag pos brgyan/ cung zad rtsub pa'i bsam pa dang ldan pas bdag bskyed nas bzung mjug gi bar gong ma rnams dang 'dra zhing*/ khyad par 'das ma 'das gnyis ka mdangs dang 'od zer nag po 'phro ba/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan zhes pa dang*/ dgang gzar blugs khro bo'i khu tshur gyis blug gzar g.yon dang*/ dgang gzar g.yas su bzung*/ spel tshig gi tshe/ bstan pa la sdang ba'i dgra bgegs gdug pa thams cad mā ra ya phaṭa/ ces mgo mjug thams cad la sbyor ba'i rigs 'gre zhing*/ bsreg rdzas thams cad lag pa g.yas kyis gzung g.yon kho nas 'bul/ me ma shi na dug chus gzhil/ gzhan cho ga thams cad zhi ba dang 'dra'o// gal te las bzhi so so'i bud shing ma 'byor na/ nags kyi lci ba skam po srog chags med pas byas kyang rung zhing*/ yam shing yang ma 'byor na bal bu sogs 'o ma can gyi shing gis byas kyang rung bar bshad do// de ltar rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i// las bzhi'i sbyin sreg bklags pas don 'grub 'di// rgya chen gzhung dang bla ma'i man ngag la// brten nas sbyar la nyes skyon med par sems// bdag blo dman zhing sbyangs pa chung ba'i phyir// mkhas pa dgyes pa'i legs bshad ma mchis so// gong ma'i gsung ltar 'khrul med bris pas dge /skul ba po yi bzhed don 'grub par shog /ces pa 'di yang gcig tu chos la thugs rgyud gzhol ba dpal ra chos mdzad ngag dbang 'jam dpal gyis gser gyi me tog dang bcas bskul ma gnang ba'i bzhed pa skong phyir drin chen mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub kyi zhabs rdul yun ring du bsten pa'i bka' 'bangs kyi tha chung ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub kyis bgrang gzhi bcu phrag bdun dang nyag ma gcig tu slebs pa khro mo'i khrum zla ba'i dkar phyogs dge bar dpal ldan rmor gyi rang gi bsam gtan khang bur sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni kun dga' dbang phyug gis bgyis pa 'dis kyang tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po'i bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas pa'i rgyur gyur cig
